description: Derived UI fixture joining the existing curated real-system seed library to nearby-star astrometry and IAU constellation boundary geometry. It is not authoritative simulation state.

coordinate_conventions.sky: Right ascension in hours/degrees and declination in degrees as listed by the nearby-star source. That source does not state a coordinate epoch; do not treat these values as a time-specific ephemeris.
coordinate_conventions.spatial: Cartesian equatorial coordinates in light-years, derived from source RA, declination, and distance. X points to RA 0h/Dec 0°, Y to RA 6h/Dec 0°, Z to the north celestial pole.
coordinate_conventions.boundary: IAU constellation boundary polygon coordinates in degrees of right ascension and declination. The boundary catalog is J2000-based; seed-position epoch mismatch remains a source limitation.

sources.name: Galaxies3D — Nearest Stars and Brown Dwarfs: Data
sources.note: Source table does not state coordinate epoch; values are used as supplied.

sources.name: D3-Celestial boundary geometry
sources.note: Redistributed GeoJSON boundary geometry; see project data README for format and source lineage.

regions.name: Local Bubble
regions.note: Physical neighborhood context only. This fixture does not invent a Local Bubble boundary.

systems.name: Alpha Centauri
systems.note: The game seed groups Alpha Centauri A, Alpha Centauri B, and Proxima Centauri in one star system. The map node uses the published Alpha Centauri AB position as the system reference point; Proxima is retained as a separately sourced component position.
